item.title: Extension points
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Extension points

These partials are not shipped with the theme — the theme’s templates call them, but each site is expected to provide them in its own layouts/partials/. The theme checks their existence and warns (or errors) if they are missing where required.

This example site implements all of them — see the _partials and partials directories for a working reference.

li.html (required for list pages)

Called for every page in list templates — it renders a single list entry. Place it in layouts/_partials/li.html.

item.title: Helper partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Helper partials

Utility partials — most of them return a value and are used like functions. They can be called from site layouts, too.

Functions (functions/)

Partial Purpose
functions/arrays/filter-nil.html Removes nil entries from a slice (input: slice)
functions/arrays/join.html Joins a string slice (input: slice, optional separator)
functions/arrays/reverse-slice.html Reverses a slice
functions/files/slice-filter-non-existing.html Filters missing resources out of a file list (input: files, context)
functions/inline-svg.html Inlines an SVG file (svg = path) as HTML, errors if the file is missing
functions/debug/enabled.html {#debug} Returns the debug flag from the site parameter debug (memoized via partialCached) — used to guard extra build warnings
functions/debug/var.html Debug dumps a variable with printf "%#v"
functions/i18n/default-lang Returns the default site language name
functions/i18n/page-for-lang.html Returns a page’s translation for a language (input: context, lang)
functions/i18n/site-langs Returns all configured site languages
functions/tags/tag2str Normalizes tag input (string, Term or taxonomy entry) to a string
functions/iiif/presentation-version.html Resolves the IIIF Presentation version for a page
hugo/site/AllPages All pages of all sites, multilingual aware — workaround for Hugo’s .Site.AllPages behavior

Data lookups

  • data/wikidata.html — renders a “Wikidata entries” summary block for a page: reads the wikidata front matter (string, list or map with relations), resolves the entity labels through data/functions/wikidata-label.html and links them. The label lookup queries the SPARQL endpoint configured with the site parameter wikidatasparqlendpoint

Services

  • services/cookie-consent.html — renders a cookie consent notice with accept/deny buttons (i18n labels, optional privacy policy link in the dict input). Currently not wired into the theme — a site includes it and pairs it with the html/head/dnt-cookie.html partial and its analytics scripts

Preview images

  • preview/prerendered.html — finds a prerendered preview image for a page using the site parameter preview (outputPrefix, outputSuffix, language specific variants)
  • preview/preview-internal.html — internal preview rendering (image processing), input: context, fit, optional postProcess
  • preview/image.html — optional site extension point

Shortcode assets

  • shortcodes/shortcode-helper.html — the core of the shortcode helper system: checks which shortcodes a page uses and returns a JSON map of the JS/CSS/SCSS assets they need. The site parameter skipShortcodeAssets: true disables it
  • shortcodes/shortcode-helper-cache.html / -extract-matches.html — build the include cache from the asset manifests
  • shortcodes/mermaid/block.html — renders a Mermaid diagram block for the mermaid shortcode

Miscellaneous

  • html/comment.html — renders a string as an HTML comment
  • macros/strip-links.html — returns a page’s content as plain text
  • macros/remove-shortcodes.txt — strips shortcode markers from raw content (used by the GeoJSON popups)
  • fonts/css.html — publishes font CSS resources (assets/css/fonts/*.css); currently emits a build warning, work in progress — see the font infrastructure note in the README
  • pdf-viewer.html — renders a PDF viewer for a page resource named pdf-viewer (used by the pdf shortcodes) plus a download link
  • geojson/feature.geojson, featureCollection.geojson — GeoJSON assembly, see GeoJSON template

item.title: IIIF partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
IIIF partials

The iiif/ partials render IIIF content and build the JSON documents for the IIIF output formats. Configuration and front matter are documented in the IIIF section.

Viewers

These partials render viewer markup for a page’s resources. They are called by the IIIF shortcodes and by consuming sites directly:

Partial Purpose
iiif/iiif-image.html Image API viewer (OpenLayers). Called with a dict of context (resource), contextPath, pageURL, pageContext and site
iiif/_iiif-image.html Internal markup used by the image viewer
iiif/iiif-presentation.html Presentation API viewer (TIFY) for a page’s manifest (iiifManifest front matter parameter)
iiif/iiif-presentation-pdf.html Presentation viewer with PDF download link (site parameter pdfDownload)
iiif/presentation/mirador.html Mirador viewer for a page’s manifest
iiif/iiif-content.html Renders a page’s IIIF image resources directly (Image API iiifcontext), CSS class from the subtype and iiifclass page parameters
iiif/kenburns.html Ken Burns style slideshow over the page’s resources (the featured parameter selects images)
iiif/preview.html Renders a preview image of a page’s IIIF resource, called with the page or a dict of context, name and src

Site parameters

Parameter Used by Purpose
productionIIIFURLPrefix iiif-presentation.html, mirador.html URL prefix for manifests in production builds (parts are commented out, currently unused)
pdfDownload iiif-presentation-pdf.html PDF download link
minimalUI viewer partials Minimal viewer UI
disableScale viewer partials Disable scaling
iiif.presentationVersion manifest generation, see version resolution Presentation API version 3 or 4

Manifest and collection building blocks

The JSON partials under iiif/3/ and iiif/4/ assemble the Presentation API documents — they are called by the IIIF templates, iiif/4/manifest.json is dispatched dynamically by the resolved presentation version:

item.title: Media type partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Media type partials

The media/ partials render description blocks for digitized media items (the output of the Projektemacher digitization projects). They are designed to be dispatched by the page’s type front matter parameter from a site layout, e.g.:

{{ partial (printf "media/%s.html" .Params.type) . }}

Shared behavior

All media partials render a description block with a translated heading (aboutTheNeu + the item type) and the description body:

Front matter parameter Purpose
itemDescription Item description, preferred
description Fallback description

Both are markdownified.

item.title: Metadata partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Metadata partials

The metadata/ partials build the JSON-LD documents for the metadata output formats. They can also be called from site templates to reuse parts of the metadata generation.

schema.org

Partial Purpose
metadata/schema.org/schema.org.html Dispatcher — selects the site provided template, see extension points
schema.org/home.html Home page metadata (shipped, overridable)
schema.org/post.html Blog post metadata (shipped, overridable)
metadata/schema.org/util/author.html Author entity from author/authors front matter or site parameters
metadata/schema.org/util/about.html about entities
metadata/schema.org/util/iiif.html IIIF related entities

Author related site parameters: schemaPerson, publisher, orcid, author, authors.

item.title: Plug-in dispatch
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Plug-in dispatch

Several theme features select a partial by name at build time — new variants can be added by a site without touching the theme.

Tag cloud

The tags/cloud shortcode and meta/tags.html render each tag through a partial selected by name:

  • meta/tags.html: the page parameter render names the variant, prefixed with tag- (default: tag.html)
  • tags/cloud shortcode: each key in the shortcode is used as the partial name directly

Shipped variants (all receive the tag as input, via the tag2str normalizer which accepts strings, terms and taxonomy entries):

item.title: Print partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Print partials

The print/ partials are building blocks for print editions (books, brochures). They are used together with the baseof.print.html template, the print stylesheets and the print/* shortcodes. A consuming site assembles its own print template from them.

print/print-pages.html

The main assembler: renders all pages of the site (via hugo/site/AllPages) in weight order as print pages. Requires a dict parameter:

Parameter Type Default Purpose
context page — Current page context
pages page list all pages Pages to render
op string lt Weight comparison operator
weight int 10000 Weight threshold — pages with a weight below it are rendered

print/page.html

Renders a single page as <article class="singe-page" data-title="…">. Input: the page.

item.title: Structural partials
item.author: mail@christianmahnke.de (Christian Mahnke)
item.description:
Structural partials

These partials render the common page chrome. They are used by the theme’s templates and can be called (or overridden) by sites — the consuming sites projektemacher.org and labs.projektemacher.org call most of them from their own layouts.

head.html

Renders the complete <head> content: title, meta description, the main JavaScript bundle (with the IIIF viewer concatenated if the page has an iiifcontext), external stylesheets, the compiled SCSS, favicons and <link> alternates for the RSS and iiif-collection output formats.
